basic_details.job_title: Sindhudurg District Mahsul Sevak (Kotwal) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 15 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Sindhudurg District has notified 15 contractual vacancies for the Mahsul Sevak (Kotwal) post on a purely temporary and ad-hoc basis, open only to local residents of the respective taluka. The post carries a consolidated pay of Rs. 15,000 per month. Eligible candidates can apply offline from 2 October 2026 to 17 October 2026 at 6:15 PM by collecting the prescribed form by paying Rs. 50 cash and submitting the completed form in person at the respective Tehsildar Office Devgad, Kankavli or Vaibhavwadi. how_to_apply: Obtain the prescribed application form from the respective Tehsildar Office (Devgad, Kankavli, or Vaibhavwadi) by paying Rs. 50/- in cash between 02.10.2026 and 17.10.2026 (up to 06:15 PM).

Fill out the application form completely with accurate details and attach self-attested copies of required educational, age, domicile, and caste certificates along with a passport-size photograph pasted on the form.

Submit the completed application form in person at the respective Tehsildar Office on all working days (including 17.10.2026 despite it being a government holiday). Applications sent via post, courier, or email will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must be local residents of the respective taluka where they are applying. Candidates must have knowledge of Marathi. Candidates must be physically and mentally fit to perform Kotwal duties. Candidates must be between 18 and 40 years of age as of 02.10.2026. Upper age relaxations apply to reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Mahsul Sevak (Kotwal) post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is purely temporary, ad-hoc, and on a full-time consolidated pay basis as a government servant.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible to apply for these vacancies?
faq.answer: Candidates must be local residents of the respective taluka (Devgad, Kankavli, or Vaibhavwadi), have passed at least the 4th standard, and meet the age requirement of 18 to 40 years as of 02.10.2026.

faq.question: Q3. Can applications be submitted via post or email?
faq.answer: No, applications must be submitted in person directly at the respective Tehsildar Office. Submissions via post, courier, email, or other electronic media are strictly rejected.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee structure?
faq.answer: The application form costs Rs. 50/- in cash. Additionally, the examination fee is Rs. 200/- for reserved category candidates and Rs. 300/- for unreserved candidates.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any negative marking in the written examination?
faq.answer: No, there is no negative marking in the 100-mark written examination.
